claims_for_research.claim: Pydantic v2 extra="forbid" raises a validation error for undeclared input fields.
Pydantic 2.13.5 model_copy(update=...) copies update values without validating them.
SQLite permits one simultaneous write transaction; BEGIN IMMEDIATE starts it immediately or can fail with SQLITE_BUSY when another writer is active.
SQLite trigger RAISE(ABORT, message) terminates the current query and returns SQLITE_CONSTRAINT with the supplied message.
Python 3.12 hashlib provides sha256 and hexdigest returns a hexadecimal digest representation.
RFC 8785 orders JSON property names by UTF-16 code units and requires UTF-8 encoding of canonical serialization.
